open_issues.impact: the commit takes these three files
open_issues.text: Edited packages/orch/unit.json (events list), packages/orch/docs/events.md and packages/orch/lib/orch/conductor/engine.py (method binding) outside the declared write_set; unit.json must list provided events and the contract test checks it.
Design says duration is not specified, but aicore event data forbids floats, so the events carry integer duration_ms, not duration_s.

open_issues.next: P12.2 may link stage-level events if needed
open_issues.text: causationid of agent.started is not set: the design names stage.finished as the cause, but stage.finished is emitted after the agents of the stage. finished/failed point to started. For the advisor the original problem ref is a step name, not an event id, so it is not used as causationid.

open_issues.impact: error.class for conductor-side stops is not an error/v1 class
open_issues.text: error.class falls back to 'unknown' when the failure has no error/v1 class (e.g. a Stop code or crash); the code carries the Stop code or exception name.

open_issues.next: P12.2 reuse _agent_event pattern; P12.3 redact data before emit
open_issues.text: Emission needs P12.2/P12.3 to know: events.emit now returns the event id; Conductor._agent_event is the emission helper; redaction of error text is not needed as only class/code are carried.

summary: Added orch.agent.started/finished/failed (closed event-data/v1 schemas, valid/invalid fixtures, unit.json, EVENT_TYPES), emitted from roles.agent_start/agent_end so every agent run incl. report-fixer is covered. Subject <run>/<item>/<agent_run_id>, correlationid = run id, causationid of finished/failed = started event id. stage.finished got optional work_id, item, config_digest. events.emit takes correlationid and returns the event id. Test in test_conductor.DigestTests; docs/events.md and CHANGELOG updated. Tests run: test_events, DigestTests, test_conductor_agents, test_characterization, test_boundaries (all green). V1 ran once, exit 0, before the last edits (duration_ms rename, docs, CHANGELOG); the coordinator must rerun it.
